name: Scoffers
overview: Scripture warns that scoffers, or scorners, reject godly counsel and rebuke, leading to judgment and strife (Proverbs 13:1; 19:29; 22:10). The Psalms highlight the danger of associating with the scornful, contrasting their path with the blessed man who avoids their counsel (Psalms 1:1). Christ’s teaching in Matthew connects the days of scoffing with the coming judgment, likening the present age to the days of Noah when many rejected God's warning (Matthew 24:22,37). Believers are thus called to discern and separate from scoffers, recognizing the serious consequences foretold in Scripture.
